goal: Removes dead cache-invalidation and GUI-notification code left over after a prior wallet refactor moved balance tracking out of per-tx caches
Aims to simplify wallet internals for maintainers by dropping computation that no longer changes cached values
reviewability: Ready to review now, CI passes and no rebase needed
A correctness edge case was raised two days ago and is worth checking before merge but doesn't block review
agreement: Multiple concept ACKs and full ACKs after the code stabilized (w0xlt, rkrux, Bicaru20, pablomartin4btc)
Unaddressed objection: a failing functional test shows gettransaction under-reports amount after keypool expansion, no author reply (w0xlt)
Overall sentiment is disputed due to the late unresolved correctness concern

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because this is mostly dead-code cleanup following an earlier refactor, offering limited standalone value
A reviewer found a narrow but real correctness regression where a spend causing keypool expansion leads to an under-reported transaction amount
The regression is acknowledged as a very narrow edge case, keeping the overall impact modest
